topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: Different indexes may include the same securities.
question: Misconception: If a non-traditional index fund is less correlated with the market, it automatically makes a portfolio more diversified and less risky.
answer: Not necessarily. Lower market correlation may make a fund behave differently, but indexes can still hold many of the same securities or give certain holdings more weight than expected. To assess whether it adds diversity, examine how its index is constructed and what the fund actually holds.
